His favorite three words are tussle, thwart and thrash.|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Bouncer''', internally referred to as '''KingpinBouncer''', is a unit spawned by the [[Kingpin]] at Level 4B or higher. The '''Bouncer''' receives two upgrades, one when the [[Kingpin]] is upgraded to Level 5B and one when upgraded to Level 6B. Like most other units, it starts from one of the entrances of the map and moves towards the exit. Whenever there is a detectable enemy in its range, it will stop moving to attack it. It will continue walking if there are no enemies in its range for a few seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Bouncer''' has pale skin, brown hair and a muscular body. It wears a white ripped shirt with a red vest and a Darker brown pants with black shoes. Its hands are covered in bandages that almost look like fist gloves and it wears a red cap. It wields a barbed wire bat that it uses to attack enemies. ==Statistics== {{neow| $DPS$ = Damage / Firerate $RDPS$ = Health * (Defense * 0.01 + 1) / Spawn Time

}} ==Strategy== *The '''Bouncer''' has the second highest DPS and the highest ram DPS, though it has the lowest range out of all offensive. *While the [[Kingpin]] does not have hidden detection, the '''Bouncer''' does, meaning it can be used to deal with [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies. *The '''Bouncer''' is unlocked at Level 4B, where the [[Kingpin]] does not have lead detection. This means it can be used to handle [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies that may spawn in the mode. **This will be far less notable once the [[Kingpin]] is upgraded to Level 6B, as the tower itself will have lead detection by then. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} KingpinThumbnail.png|'''Bouncer''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} KingpinBoomerangUpdateIcon.png|'''Bouncer''' on the game icon. }} ==Update History== *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **[[Bouncer]] added. **{{Bug}} '''Bouncer''' deals no damage to [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. *'''7 August 2026''' - [[v2.5.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Bouncer''' now deals damage to [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. *'''14 August 2026''' - [[v2.6.0]] **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Health decreased from 550 to 500. {{TowerNavBox}}
